card.name: Linking words before drug-class nouns
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, with, which, receive, multiple) right after exposure, treatment or sensitivity, when the next word is likely a drug class or agent such as antihypertensive, inhibitors or allergens.

modes.label: Exposure to drug class
modes.description: The word 'to' after 'exposure', just before a drug class name.
modes.example: fetal abnormalities after exposure<< to>> antihypertensive use in the

modes.label: Treatment or drugs with a class
modes.description: Linking words such as 'with' or 'which' that lead into a named group of drugs.

modes.label: Sensitivity to multiple allergens
modes.description: The word 'multiple' after 'sensitivity to', before a plural agent noun.
modes.example: a history of sensitivity to<< multiple>> allergens. Before initiating therapy with am

card.writes: It pushes the model toward agent-like words (agent, agents) as the next word.
card.plain: It fires on small linking words that come just before a drug class or an agent is named.
